description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'ModelMenuAction' and an inner class 'SetField' for managing menu actions and setting field values within a widget model in the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for reading sub-actions from XML, executing actions, and handling variable scoping and type conversions.

classes.name: ModelMenuAction
classes.description: An abstract class representing menu actions within the widget model, providing static methods to read sub-actions from XML elements.

classes.name: SetField
classes.description: An inner static class extending AbstractModelAction, used for setting values of fields based on XML configuration, with support for scope, default values, and type conversion.

methods.name: readSubActions
methods.description: Reads sub-actions defined within a parent XML element, creating a list of ModelAction objects based on the element types.
